theme: Light-first, with optional dark admin workspace

design_concepts.name: Freight Ledger
design_concepts.description: Swiss editorial booking experience fused with Indian wayfinding and industrial ledger details. Best balance of trust, clarity, and conversion.

design_concepts.name: Roadside Dispatch
design_concepts.description: Tactical fleet operations language fused with roadside signage and documentary photography. Strongest for admin and availability views.

design_concepts.name: Material Route
design_concepts.description: Warm paper, stamped labels, and map-grid geometry fused with modern SaaS form patterns. Most human and approachable for customers.

design_concepts.name: Container Index
design_concepts.description: Editorial catalog fused with shipping manifests and modular Tetris layout. Strong product browsing and SEO storytelling.

design_concepts.name: Night Yard
design_concepts.description: Dark, high-contrast dispatch console fused with reflective safety markings. Reserve for admin dashboards, not the customer booking funnel.

discovery.content_strategy: Lead with a simple promise, then show vehicle fit, availability, price estimate, booking steps, and proof of operational control. Use Indian Rupee and dd/MM/yyyy with Asia/Kolkata timezone.

research.descriptor: Service-first information architecture, calculator-led conversion, route transparency, and modular service grids.

research.reference: Flexport and Ascent PEAK dashboard patterns
research.descriptor: Widget hierarchy, centralized allocation, filterable operational views, and clear KPI summaries.
Month for broad comparison, week/agenda for operational detail, explicit selected and unavailable states, stable loading containers.

typography.headings: Bebas Neue or Anton, 900 weight, tracking-tight; use only for high-impact display labels and H1/H2, never body copy.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans, 400/500/600; highly legible for forms, tables, and Indian addresses.
typography.mono: IBM Plex Mono for booking IDs, vehicle codes, prices, and timestamps.
rules: never use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast with warm industrial tint
rules: 95% UI remains bone, paper, blue-charcoal, and stone
use vermilion only for primary CTAs and urgent status
verify normal text at 4.5:1 and large text at 3:1

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle CSS grain/noise overlay at low opacity, plus faint route-map linework; decorative layers aria-hidden=true.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid customer surfaces with 1px borders and nested 4px/8px radii. Admin uses cardless grid borders. No transparent content surfaces.
visual_enhancers.image_treatment: If imagery is added, use real vehicle/loading scenes with warm documentary crop, max bg-black/40 overlay, and never obscure the vehicle.
visual_enhancers.scrollbar: Customize to slim warm-stone track and vermilion thumb; no scrollbar gutter.

grids.marketing: Tetris grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12, gap-8 lg:gap-12; mix full hero, 4-column vehicle tiles, tall availability panel, and empty offset cells.
grids.dashboard: High-density grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4; primary booking queue spans 2 columns and 2 rows, feed is tall narrow, KPI cells are single columns.
rules: align-items-start unless a panel must stretch
do not fill every cell perfectly
all bordered content gets p-6 or p-8

layouts.header: Sticky solid paper or opaque backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFFDF8]/90 with border-b, z-50, desktop links Home, Vehicles, Vehicle Availability, Book Vehicle, My Booking, Contact Us, Login/Register, and primary Book a Vehicle CTA. Mobile uses Sheet menu.
layouts.home: Left-aligned editorial hero with booking intent panel offset to the right on desktop; vehicle catalog follows as an asymmetrical grid; finish with process and dark contrast footer.
layouts.booking: Four-step left-anchored flow: vehicle and schedule, route/trip, customer details, review/payment. Keep estimate visible as a sticky side rail on desktop and a bottom summary on mobile.
layouts.admin: Desktop-only optimized shell with left rail, top context bar, KPI strip, booking queue, and assignment drawer. Tables remain dense but never clipped; horizontal scroll on small screens.
layouts.footer: Deep route-blue contrast shift, py-20 or py-32, large brand wordmark plus contact and service links.

motion.entrance: Stagger sections 60ms with opacity and translate-y; vehicle tiles reveal on scroll.
motion.interaction: Buttons use transform translate-y/-1 and background-color transitions; rows highlight on hover; selected vehicle gets crisp vermilion rule.
motion.loading: Skeletons retain final heights; availability uses pulsing route ticks.
motion.reduced_motion: Disable parallax, stagger, and decorative animation under prefers-reduced-motion; preserve state changes with color and borders.
motion.rule: Never use transition-all. Animate only transform, opacity, background-color, border-color, and box-shadow.

requirements: Every button, link, input, menu, error, balance, confirmation, and key metric requires data-testid in kebab-case.
Use visible focus:ring-2 ring-secondary with high-contrast offset.
Never communicate availability by color alone; include Available, Held, or Booked text.
Use labels and helper text for pickup/delivery, date/time, cargo, and payment.
Use Shadcn Calendar, Select, Dialog, Sheet, Form, and Sonner; never native date/select for advanced interactions.
Announce booking ID and confirmation status in an aria-live region.
Use Indian locale formatting: en-IN, INR, Asia/Kolkata.

media.policy: No images are required for the first implementation. If images are introduced, obtain them only through image_selector_tool; do not use placeholder URLs. Categories: hero vehicle, vehicle type detail, optional driver/team trust image.
media.responsive: Images max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none on mobile and object-cover with descriptive alt text.

3d libraries.decision: Do not use 3D for the first MVP; booking clarity beats immersion.
future: React Three Fiber + Drei for optional vehicle configurator
React Map GL for future route visualization
Recharts/Shadcn charts for revenue and utilization
steps: keep background transparent only for decorative canvas

implementation.stack: React, Tailwind, FastAPI, MongoDB, Shadcn primitives.
data_contract: booking IDs are human-readable and unique
server validates vehicle availability and prevents overlapping bookings atomically
notifications are stored in-app with email-ready adapter mocked
payment methods Pay Later, Cash, Bank Transfer; verified status is server-controlled
seed vehicles are editable, never hardcoded only in UI

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Do not center the entire app container or set App text-align center.
Avoid generic centered layouts, SaaS gradients, excessive rounded cards, and uniform equal grids.
Use 2-3x generous spacing and negative space.
Use explicit hover, active, focus, selected, empty, error, and loading states.
Headers must have opaque or blurred backgrounds; never complete transparent content surfaces.
Use modern pill or sharp buttons with clear pressed feedback.
Avoid AI assistant emoji characters as icons; use lucide-react or existing Shadcn icons.
Prefer raw HTML/Tailwind for marketing structure and Shadcn for interactive app/admin controls.
Customize shadows and borders with warm or blue tint; no universal transition.
Keep customer mobile-first and admin desktop-first while maintaining responsive fallbacks.
